brief:
Israeli forces carried out mass home demolitions in a southern West Bank village on Wednesday, leaving dozens of Palestinians homeless, Middle East Eye reported. The operation displaced hundreds of residents amid what the outlet described as a wave of demolitions across the occupied territory.

The demolitions occurred in what Israeli authorities have characterized as an unauthorized construction zone, though Palestinians view the operations as part of a broader pattern of displacement in the West Bank.
dek: Israel displaces hundreds of Palestinians amid wave of demolitions in West Bank Israeli forces carried out a mass home demolition campaign in a village in the southern occupied West Bank on Wednesday, leaving dozens of Palestinians homeless.
title: Israeli forces demolish homes, displace hundreds in West Bank village
